| rcore | `SetGamepadVibration` | verified | Implemented via SDL's gamepad subsystem (SDL3) on the desktop backend because GLFW exposes no haptics API. GLFW retains windowing/input; SDL initializes only SDL_INIT_GAMEPAD. The public (GLFW slot) index is mapped to the matching SDL controller by joystick GUID + connection order. Motors [0,1] map to SDL Uint16, duration is in seconds; zeros stop rumble. Requires SDL3 at build time (MEOWY_USE_SDL_GAMEPAD, ON by default); without it this is a documented no-op. Mapping/conversion/lifecycle are tested by gamepad_rumble_checks; physical motor movement is reported UNVERIFIED without a connected controller. |
